_comment: Real Cantus Index chant texts, used by auto_split.test.js. Curated rather than
exhaustive: two or three per convention, plus every chant named in the rules'
header comment and the ground-truth cases. 'category' records which convention the
text was chosen to exercise, and is what the invariant failures point at.
Fetched from https://cantusindex.org/json-text/<term> and /json-cid/<id>. To resample
